metadata.description: Black Box Safety internal Claude plugins — site operations, state sales, and AI foundations.

plugins.name: bbs-website
plugins.description: Maintain the BBS website end to end — price list to live product page. Catalog intake and import, contract pricing, variant families, enrichment, storefront pages, quote-bot lane tuning, QA and cross-sell.

plugins.name: bbs-sales
plugins.description: The California state quote desk, end to end: log an inbound RFQ, pull items out of whatever the agency sent (DWR RFQ PDF, Grainger cart, or a screenshot), check DGS BPO eligibility, price it through the Grainger MCP or vendor sourcing, build the customer quote on BBS letterhead, and fill the CDCR and CA compliance packets. Plus Grainger promo pages.

plugins.name: bbs-back-office
plugins.description: What happens after the bid is won: read the truth out of Business Central. Where an order stands, what a vendor still owes us, what a problem order actually needs, and what the deal earned once Grainger rebates are applied.

plugins.name: bbs-foundations
plugins.description: Company-wide AI foundations: the BBS way to write CLAUDE.md files (BBSClaudeMDForge), the doctrine every skill inherits, the shared company facts, systems of record, and certification rules that keep every repo and customer folder consistent, and order reconciliation — diagnosing and resolving problems on orders already placed.

plugins.name: claudeforge
plugins.description: Pinned external dependency of bbs-foundations: the generic CLAUDE.md engine (150-line cap, @path chaining, /enhance-claude-md, /sync-claude-md, drift/link/dependency audits). BBS fork of alirezarezvani/ClaudeForge; bbs-claude-md-forge supplies the BBS doctrine on top of it.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Pinned external design skill for anything with a frontend: /impeccable polish, audit, critique, typeset, layout, and 61 deterministic anti-pattern detector rules. Used on customer-facing HTML (dossiers, landing pages, quote bot, storefront). BBS fork of pbakaus/impeccable (v4.3.1); update by syncing the fork from upstream.

plugins.name: superpowers-chrome
plugins.description: Commons: drives the rep's real Chrome over the DevTools protocol (logged-in sessions, product research on distributor and agency sites). Skill mode needs Node.js (bbs-setup.ps1 installs it). Upstream self-labels beta. Single tag train (vX.Y.Z), so the pin is a release tag and is checked quarterly per docs/COMMONS.md.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Commons: terse output mode (/caveman lite|full|ultra) that cuts roughly two-thirds of output tokens while keeping technical content exact. Opt-in per session; ruled 2026-09-13. Narrowed with skills: to the mode skill and its /caveman-help reference card — the pinned tree ships 20 skills, and the other 18 are developer-facing and would compete for selection in a rep's session. Multi-train upstream (nine tag prefixes); the authoritative train is bare vX.Y.Z, checked monthly per docs/COMMONS.md. v2.7.0 is taken for a Windows fix: both hook commands now convert an MSYS /c/... path back to C:/... before invoking node.

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Commons: Anthropic's official document skills — Word (tracked changes, comments), PDF (extract, merge, fill, annotate), Excel (formulas, charts), PowerPoint (build with pptxgenjs, read with markitdown). RFQ worksheets, bid PDFs, price lists, and the deck assembly step bbs-deck-voice hands off to. Rolling upstream with no tags, so the pin is a commit SHA of anthropics/skills and is checked monthly per docs/COMMONS.md. Caveat recorded there: the pptx visual-QA and PDF paths need LibreOffice, which bbs-setup.ps1 does not install.
